v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ecce quam bonum * et quam iucúndum habitáre fratres in unum. ‡
text.en: Behold how good * and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. ‡

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quia in humilitáte nostra memor fuit nostri.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for he was mindful of us in our affliction.

text.la: Adhǽreat lingua mea * fáucibus meis, si non memínero tui Ierúsalem.
text.en: Let my tongue cleave to my jaws * if I do not remember thee, Jerusalem.

text.la: Confitébor * nómini tuo, Dómine, super misericórdia et veritáte tua.
text.en: I will give glory * to thy name, for thy mercy, and for thy truth.

text.la: Beátus vir, qui suffert tentatiónem: quóniam cum probátus fúerit, accípiet corónam vitæ, quam repromísit Deus diligéntibus se.
text.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation; for when he hath been proved, he shall receive a crown of life, which God hath promised to them that love him.

v.en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.

r.en: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

text.la: Qui vult veníre post me, * ábneget semetípsum, et tollat crucem suam, et sequátur me.
text.en: If any man will come after me, * let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.

text.la: Deus, qui nos beáti Eusébii Mártyris tui atque Pontíficis ánnua solemnitáte lætíficas: concéde propítius; ut, cuius natalítia cólimus, de eiúsdem étiam protectióne gaudeámus.
text.en: O God, who year by year dost gladden us by the solemn feast day of thy Blessed Martyr and Bishop Eusebius, mercifully grant that we who keep his birthday, may ever feel the joyful effects of his protection.

title.la: Feria V infra Hebdomadam III Adventus
title.en: Feria V infra Hebdomadam III Adventus

text.la: Lætámini cum Ierúsalem, et exsultáte in ea, omnes qui dilígitis eam, in ætérnum.
text.en: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her for ever.

v.la: Roráte, cæli, désuper, et nubes pluant iustum.
v.en: Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain the Just.

r.en: Let the earth be opened, and bud forth the Saviour.

text.la: Aurem tuam, quǽsumus, Dómine, précibus nostris accómmoda: et mentis nostræ ténebras, grátia tuæ visitatiónis illústra:
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee, mercifully incline thine ears unto our prayers, and lighten the darkness of our minds by the grace of thy heavenly visitation.
